guidance: Keep the design sketch short and actionable. Name real components and interfaces. Prefer explicit sequencing for rollout. Call out only material risks. Use code blocks or compact tables for schemas when helpful. Do not expand into a full RFC unless the user asks.

outline.title: Context
outline.guidance: Frame the change before diving into components.

children.title: Background
children.guidance: Briefly summarize the system being touched, the change goal, and any hard constraints.

outline.title: System Components
outline.guidance: Group the services or modules involved. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Component
children.guidance: Title each instance with the service/module/UI name, not "Component".

children.title: Responsibilities
children.guidance: What this component owns and must guarantee.

children.title: Interfaces
children.guidance: How it talks to other parts (APIs, events, props, queues). Prefer short bullet lists or a tiny table.

outline.title: Data Models
outline.guidance: Group entities being stored or changed. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Entity
children.guidance: Title each instance with the entity name, not "Entity".

children.title: Attributes
children.guidance: Key fields and types being stored or changed. Use a small table when there are several fields.

children.title: Relationships
children.guidance: How this entity links to existing data.

outline.title: Rollout Strategy
outline.guidance: Describe how the change ships safely.

children.title: Deployment Steps
children.guidance: Numbered sequencing (e.g., migrate, deploy backend, flip flag). Include rollback only if non-obvious.

children.title: Risks
children.guidance: Bullet list of material implementation or operational risks and mitigations. Omit if none.
